wv-spawn: Arrival on the elevated Addison Red Line island platform (y 7.6): platform furniture/signage, twin tracks alongside, Wrigleyville streets below; down-the-platform framing, not clipped into walls.
wv-marquee: THE shot: the red Wrigley Field marquee on the ROUNDED Clark & Addison corner, reading like the real sign per the owner ref: arched crown with 'WRIGLEY FIELD' set along the arc, small 'HOME OF' over large 'CHICAGO CUBS', art-deco scroll shoulders, white pinstripe trim, and a black rounded message board with DOT-MATRIX lettering (live message line). Behind it the facade reads as a looming GRANDSTAND, not a storefront (012/IMG_2333): green steel column rhythm rising to the rim, red-brick band + red-tile pent over the ground floor, arched-window band at the crown, and a flag ring (Chicago city flag among them) above the marquee. A Chicagoan should recognize THIS sign instantly.
wv-scoreboard: The hand-turned green centerfield scoreboard high atop the bleachers (base ~18, top ~26.5): line-score grid, pennants above, no video boards (classic postcard Wrigley).

wv-gate-gallagher: The Gallagher Way gate on the plaza's east side: gate recess in the west-stands facade with a red-brick pad on the plaza in front of it.
